content.comment_body: Hello, experts, I'm having trouble uploading a program to our [product_name]. I receive an 'Invalid XOR Total' error message (originally in French as 'Total Xor non valable'). Initially, I thought this indicated too many logic blocks (especially 'OR' elements) in my new program, but the same error appears when I attempt to upload the currently active program without any modifications. This error occurs regardless of the [product_name] software version used ([version_no]), and only affects the upload process—not downloading from the device to the PC. Any assistance would be appreciated. Many thanks in advance. [user_name]
Hello, If you press F2, what information is displayed on the LSC Info screen? Please share your program so it can be checked.

analysis.insight_summary: A user consistently receives an 'Invalid XOR Total' error when uploading a program to a [product_name] module using various versions of the [product_name] software. The error prevents successful uploads even for previously working, unchanged programs, suggesting the issue relates to the upload function rather than program content or software version.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects to be able to upload any program to the [product_name] module without errors, regardless of the number of logic elements included.
